provenance.method: Need-led Organisations & peer community UK v1 question; routes to inspectable resources without provider ranking, safety certification or personalised recommendation.

question: How can I find an organisation where neurodivergent or disabled people genuinely have leadership and decision-making power?
why_it_matters: People may specifically want support, advocacy or community shaped by lived experience rather than only professional or parent/carer governance.
current_understanding: Inspect the organisation's own governance rather than relying on branding. Useful signals include voting membership, board or committee control, who can hold office and whether the represented people have formal decision rights. For example, an autistic-led organisation in Scotland should still be described from evidenced governance rather than inferred from its name. ND Oracle can describe evidenced governance but does not turn 'peer-led' into a quality or safety badge.
evidence_needed: More comparable governance disclosures across UK neurodivergent organisations.
Independent evidence on how different governance models affect participant experience or outcomes.
reopening_conditions: A reviewed organisation changes its constitution or leadership model.
A reliable UK directory begins publishing comparable DPO or neurodivergent-led governance metadata.
dissent: Professional-led and parent/carer-led organisations can still provide useful services; leadership model and usefulness are separate questions.
